name: Haiku price momentum
strategy: Contrarian sector rotation: short overextended semiconductors (SOXL, +506% YTD extreme) paired with tactical long rotation into energy, financials, biotech, value, and EM; position-level stops (18% SL shorts) and take-profits (15-30% TP longs).
novelty: Contrarian short bias on extended semiconductor bubble (SOXL) paired with systematic rotation into energy, financials, value, and EM. Fundamentally reverses Rounds 1-2's long-momentum orientation; return driver is mean-reversion + sector rotation (different edge), not momentum chasing.

positions.thesis: Semiconductors up 506% YTD, extreme extension; already down -39% last month. Contrarian short on sector rotation outflow.
Biotech +82.7% YTD with +14.6% recent momentum. Sector strength and recent acceleration.
Energy +34.1% YTD with stable momentum. Macro tailwinds, defensive relative to overextended tech.
Financials +11.2% YTD, +6% recent acceleration. Rate scenario favorable, rotating into value.
Small-cap leverage +106% YTD, now consolidating. Diversification alternative to mega-cap tech concentration.
Value rotation: Russell 1000 Value +26.1% YTD. Better risk-reward post-tech extension.
Emerging markets +37.3% YTD. Geographic diversification, relative value vs US tech concentration.
Regional banks +26.5% YTD, +5.5% recent momentum. Value play in rate environment, plays financials rotation.

outlook: Sector rotation from mega-cap tech into value, energy, and financials as SOXL normalization continues. Biotech momentum may persist; small-cap consolidation could set up next leg. Emerging market rebalancing offers diversified upside. Key risk: if mega-cap momentum resumes despite valuation extremes, short SOXL underweight tech underperforms (mitigated by 18% stop loss). Time horizon aligns with 5-month score window (7/17–12/31); position-level discipline enforces disciplined exit mechanics."
